evidence: News flow leading up to November 23, 2018, reflects severe market distress and ongoing capitulation following sharp weekly price drops. Multiple reports highlight intense selling pressure, miner insolvencies (Giga Watt bankruptcy and mining rigs sold as scrap), increased hedging and shorting via crypto derivatives, and mainstream coverage declaring a crypto financial crisis. While minor positive developments appear around Lightning Network capacity growth and long-term venture commentary, short-term immediate sentiment is heavily burdened by negative momentum, panic, and mining sector capitulation, pointing to a below-even probability of an upward move over the next 24 hours.
limitations: Multiple articles covering Norwegian mining tax subsidies were deduplicated into a single policy signal.
Much of the news commentary reflects backward-looking sentiment from the recent capitulation crash rather than forward order flow.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
